visual_goal: Show the lifecycle of an overlap-register row: every row ends in a decision state, accepted rows loop back to assessment at review, and resolved rows close only with exit evidence filed.
prompt: A board-game path of rounded stepping stones; each stone carries its own label written once, inside the stone. At the far left a stone 'Detected' with a small magnifying glass, then one arrow to a stone 'Assessed' with a small clipboard. From 'Assessed' four arrows fan out to the right to four stones stacked top to bottom: green 'Accepted', amber 'Contained', blue 'In transition', grey 'Prevented' with a small stop-hand icon. One arrow from 'Contained' down into 'In transition'. One arrow from 'In transition' to the right into a stone 'Resolved' with a small filed folder and a tick. A curved arrow with a small calendar icon loops from 'Accepted' back to 'Assessed'. 'Prevented' and 'Resolved' each end at a small finish flag. Exactly nine arrows.
alt: An overlap-register row moves from Detected to Assessed, then to Accepted, Contained, In transition or Prevented; Contained moves to In transition, In transition ends in Resolved with evidence filed, and Accepted loops back to Assessed at its review date.

visual_goal: Show Northmere's overlap map: four capabilities, each with several implementations, every implementation carrying a verb and a date, and one dotted duplication that was prevented.
prompt: Four horizontal shelves stacked top to bottom on a light background. At the left end of each shelf is a capability box: 'Partner payouts', 'Invoicing', 'Reconciliation', 'Indirect tax'. A plain horizontal line runs from each capability box along its shelf, and small generic server boxes sit on that line side by side, each carrying one colored tag. Partner payouts shelf: three server boxes tagged 'Group service', 'Converge 2029', 'Accept', followed by a dotted line segment leading to a faded ghost server box with a red stop-hand and tag 'Prevented'. Invoicing shelf: four server boxes tagged 'Target', 'Converge 2028', 'Accept', 'Converge 2028-29'. Reconciliation shelf: three server boxes tagged 'Sole record 2028', 'Retire', 'Converge 2029'. Indirect tax shelf: four server boxes tagged 'Group standard', 'Migrate', 'Retire 2028', 'Exception'. Fifteen server boxes in total, one of them faded. Tag colors: green for keep, blue for converge, orange for retire or migrate, grey for exception and prevented.
alt: Four capabilities — partner payouts, invoicing, reconciliation and indirect tax — each branching to several systems tagged with a verb and date such as converge 2029 or retire 2028, with one dotted branch to a prevented duplicate.

visual_goal: Show coupling heat on Northmere's finance boundaries: the hottest edges cluster around Wayfare (shared replica, cancellations handover, quarterly vendor releases, one team on every path).
prompt: A left-to-right systems map where each connecting arrow is colored by heat: thick red for hot, amber for medium. On the left half, a soft red glowing zone surrounds a cluster: a box 'Booking platform' at the far left; one thick red arrow from it to a box 'Wayfare payouts', with a small database cylinder on that arrow; one thick red arrow from 'Wayfare payouts' to a ledger box 'Fusion GL'; one thick red arrow from 'Fusion GL' to a box 'MuleSoft' with a small calendar icon. Above the cluster, a small group of unlabeled people icons labeled 'Wayfare team' with two thick red arrows down, one into 'Wayfare payouts' and one into 'Fusion GL'. Also one amber arrow from 'Booking platform' down into a cylinder 'FinDB'. On the right half, calmer: a box 'SFP' with one thick red arrow carrying a small moon icon into a ledger box 'S/4HANA GL'; one amber arrow from 'S/4HANA GL' into a stacked-layers box 'OneStream'; one amber arrow from 'Fusion GL' across into 'OneStream'. Exactly nine arrows.
alt: A heat map of finance system boundaries: red, hot edges cluster around Wayfare — a shared database link from the booking platform, the payout engine to Fusion, vendor releases to MuleSoft and one team on every path — while the SAP side has one hot nightly window and medium edges into OneStream.

visual_goal: Show the payout-engine collapse as gated stages: shadow balance and shared replica come first, the parallel run loops back to configuration until every difference is explained, then cohort cutover and decommission.
prompt: Eight rounded stage boxes laid out as a two-row snake. Top row, left to right: 'Preconditions' with a checklist icon, 'Clear shadow balance' with a balance scale, 'Cut shared replica' with scissors cutting a cable to a database cylinder, 'Configure scope' with a sliders icon; arrows on the top row point to the right. A bend arrow goes down from 'Configure scope' to the box below it. Bottom row, from right to left: 'Re-verify bank details' with a bank building and a magnifier, 'Parallel run' with two side-by-side gears, 'Cohort cutover' with small stacks of coins crossing a bridge, and at the far bottom left 'Decommission' with a padlocked archive box; all arrows on the bottom row point to the left, ending in 'Decommission'. A small toll-gate barrier sits on each forward arrow. One curved orange arrow loops from 'Parallel run' back up to 'Configure scope'. The barrier between 'Parallel run' and 'Cohort cutover' shows a green tick.
alt: Eight gated stages from preconditions, clearing the shadow balance and cutting the shared replica, through configuration, bank-detail re-verification and a parallel run that loops back to configuration, to cohort cutover and decommissioning.
